title: Reward Modeling for Multi-Agent Orchestration
title_zh: 面向多智能体编排的奖励建模
abstract_en: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) built on Large Language Models (LLMs) require effective orchestration to coordinate specialized agents, yet training such orchestrators is hindered by limited supervision and high computational cost. We propose Orchestration Reward Modeling (OrchRM), a self-supervised framework for evaluating orchestration quality without human annotations. OrchRM leverages intermediate artifacts from multi-agent executions to construct win-lose pairs for Bradley-Terry reward model training. Unlike existing MAS test-time scaling and orchestrator training frameworks that rely on costly sub-agent rollouts, OrchRM operates directly at the orchestration level, enabling efficient and high-performing reward-guided orchestrator training and MAS test-time scaling. OrchRM improves training efficiency by up to 10x in token usage while improving MAS test-time scaling performance by up to 8% in accuracy. These gains consistently transfer across multiple domains, including mathematical reasoning, web-based question answering, and multi-hop reasoning, demonstrating orchestration-level reward modeling as a scalable direction for robust multi-agent orchestration. Code will be available at https://github.com/Wang-ML-Lab/OrchRM.
abstract_zh: 基于 Large Language Models (LLMs) 的 Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) 需要有效的 orchestrator 来协调专门化 agents，但由于监督信号有限、计算成本高，训练这类 orchestrator 仍然困难。本文提出 Orchestration Reward Modeling (OrchRM)，一种无需人工标注的自监督框架，用于评估多智能体编排质量。OrchRM 利用多智能体执行过程中的中间产物构造 win-lose pairs，并基于 Bradley-Terry 训练 reward model。不同于依赖昂贵 sub-agent rollouts 的 MAS test-time scaling 与 orchestrator training 方法，OrchRM 直接在 orchestration level 工作，从而支持更高效且性能更强的 reward-guided orchestrator training 和 MAS test-time scaling。实验显示，OrchRM 在 token 使用上最高提升 10 倍训练效率，同时在 MAS test-time scaling 中带来最高 8% 的准确率提升，并可迁移到数学推理、基于网页的问答和多跳推理等多个领域。
key_points_zh: 提出 OrchRM：一种面向多智能体 orchestration quality 的自监督 reward modeling 框架，无需人工标注。
利用 MAS 执行中的 intermediate artifacts 自动构造 win-lose pairs，并采用 Bradley-Terry 目标训练 reward model。
相比依赖 sub-agent rollouts 的方法，OrchRM 直接在 orchestration level 评估，显著降低 token 与计算开销。
实验表明训练 token 使用效率最高提升 10x，MAS test-time scaling 准确率最高提升 8%。
方法在数学推理、web-based question answering、多跳推理等任务上均表现出跨领域迁移能力。

llm_assessment.comment: OrchRM is a useful orchestration-level reward modeling approach, though its production harness contribution depends on integration with runtime controls.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: OrchRM 提供了有用的编排级奖励建模方法，但其生产级价值仍依赖于与运行时控制的结合。
